_comment: A hand-written extract for the ONE thing pack v2 added: the road class in
EDGES.flags, and a router that honours it (DESIGN.md 7.7).
Two ways between the same pair of points:
1  a MOTORWAY, straight and short  -- the only fast way across
2  a RESIDENTIAL dogleg, longer    -- the only way a bicycle may go
That shape is the assertion. A car takes the motorway because it is
shorter; a bicycle must take the dogleg, and the two routes must differ in
length. A router that ignored class would return the motorway for both and
the test would see one length twice.
Plus 3: a motorway-only spur to a dead end, so 'a bicycle is refused
outright when the only road is a motorway' has a case as well.
Coordinates on a 0.001 degree grid near Asok, like the other fixtures.
